types.name: auth.v1.MarketScope.Value
types.doc:
Value is the market-level scope:
 - ALL: no market-level restriction; new listings are automatically allowed.
 - ALLOWLIST: only the listed markets or contracts are allowed.

values.name: ALL
values.doc: Allow all current and future markets or contracts for this policy.

values.name: ALLOWLIST
values.doc: Allow only the markets or contracts listed on this policy.
